players.name: James Harden
players.body: 193 cm, 100 kg, powerful stocky adult guard, dark brown skin, close-cropped black hair, distinctive very full long black beard
players.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: production Fantasy Dual basketball videogame sprite atlas for James Harden. Subject: 193 cm, 100 kg, powerful stocky adult guard, dark brown skin, close-cropped black hair, distinctive very full long black beard. Original cyan basketball singlet and shorts with restrained gold piping, tiny FD monogram, white socks, cyan/ivory basketball shoes. Detailed hand-drawn pixel artwork, rich shaded musculature, crisp dark pixel outlines, natural realistic adult human proportions (small head about one seventh total body height), matching late-1990s premium 2D arcade sports sprite art. Genuine transparent background.
EXACT layout: square atlas divided into FOUR equal columns and FOUR equal rows, sixteen complete isolated poses. Every pose entirely inside its own cell with generous transparent margins at all sides, full hands and shoes, no limb intersects a neighbouring cell. All poses face screen RIGHT. Same scale across all sixteen poses, anchored around centre of cell, athletic consistency.
Reading order left to right top to bottom: row1 idle standing ready, idle breathing, run stride1, run stride2; row2 run stride3, run stride4, run stride5, run stride6; row3 run stride7, run stride8, gather shooting crouch with empty hands, standing shooting release extended arms; row4 airborne dunk reach with empty hand, crouched landing, wide defensive crouch hands extended, upright celebration with raised fist. Exactly16 poses, no missing cells or extra figures. Eight running frames form coherent alternating-leg loop. No basketballs, no hoop, no court, no floor, no shadows, no background, no titles, no labels, no logos except tiny FD. Keep each character smaller than cell to preserve long stride and outstretched defensive arms. Match artwork reference palette and pixel shading, not photographic or 3D.

qa.visual: Inspected all sixteen complete poses; distinct identity, natural proportions; uniform cells may be exceeded by dunk/release so derive global-component crops rather than tile clipping.
